defects.headline: No back-support specs — losing 88% of comfort-driven comparisons

sample_rejection_reasons: no information available about back support or long-wear comfort
listing does not mention harness, frame or hip belt
evidence.competitor_contrast: Osprey page specifies AirScape suspended mesh back panel + load-bearing hipbelt + adjustable torso fit

defects.suggested_fix: Add a structured comfort section: back panel construction, strap padding, torso fit range, hip-belt spec; add an FAQ answering 'Is it comfortable for a full day of walking?'
